name: My Futa Family
source:
What might happen to a shy and socially awkward guy moving to a new town into his mother's friend house? 

Riko nervously imagined the worst possibilities as he was on his way to meet the four people with whom he'd be sharing the roof for the next year. 

All of them being girls did not help his anxiety...

But should it be his biggest worry?

[From [url=https://duckworm.itch.io/myfutafamily]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个害羞且不善社交的人搬到一个新城镇，住进他母亲的朋友家里，会发生什么？

当理子去见明年将与他共享屋顶的四个人时，他紧张地想象着最坏的可能性。

她们都是女孩并没有减轻他的焦虑……

但这应该是他最大的担忧吗？
